items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: And Al Norrissee and myself, naturally, whiskey heads, we got up out of bed... and we were going out, just go out on the town a little bit.

ctx.x: Yeah, because -- oh, yes, I remember that, because he went along, took his wife and his daughter.

And Al Norrissee and myself, naturally, whiskey heads, we got up out of bed, not out of bed, maybe out of bed or out of our room in Oslo or either in Stockholm, and we were going out, just go out on the town a little bit.

And so Oxley and his wife and daughter were in the window on the, well, ground level, and they were rapping on the window, telling us to wait a minute. They going with us. I said, no, come on, let's go. I don't want to be bothered with them. So we went on. Oxley was -- he was out on the town himself, I think. And so we just ignored that, kept going, went around to the bars and whatnot, had us a few beers. Then that's it.
